items.title: The Core Matters: Aggregation of Neutral Ligand-Coated Nanoparticles in Membranes
items.abstract: The aggregation of gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) influences their optical properties, including localized surface plasmon resonance, through plasmonic coupling between adjacent particles. For hydrophobic AuNPs embedded in lipid membranes, however, the mechanisms governing aggregation remain poorly understood. Although coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations are well suited to study these processes, commonly used ligand–nanoparticle (NP) models neglect explicit core interactions. Here, we test whether core properties regulate NP aggregation by simulating multiple Martini NP models in a membrane environment. In contrast to the assumption that surface ligands effectively shield the core, we find that interactions with the environment remain sensitive to core parameters even at maximum ligand coverage. Furthermore, core–solvent interactions are consistent with a mechanism that directly drives nanoparticle aggregation. These results suggest that core interactions can contribute to the aggregation of functionalized nanoparticles.
items.authors: Jahmal J. Ennis, Julianne C. Griepenburg, Grace Brannigan
items.title_zh: 核心影响：中性配体涂层纳米颗粒在膜中的聚集
items.summary_zh: 金纳米颗粒（AuNPs）的聚集影响其光学特性，包括局部表面等离子体共振，这通过相邻颗粒之间的等离子体耦合实现。然而，对于嵌入脂质膜中的疏水性AuNPs，控制聚集的机制仍不清楚。尽管粗粒度分子动力学模拟适合研究这些过程，但常用的配体-纳米颗粒模型忽略了核心的显式相互作用。本文通过在膜环境中模拟多种Martini纳米颗粒模型，测试核心特性是否调节纳米颗粒聚集。与表面配体有效屏蔽核心的假设相反，我们发现即使在最大配体覆盖下，环境与核心的相互作用仍然敏感。此外，核心-溶剂相互作用与直接驱动纳米颗粒聚集的机制一致。这些结果表明，核心相互作用可能对功能化纳米颗粒的聚集起到重要作用。

items.title: A benchmark dataset of 86 intermolecular interactions of neutrals, ions, radicals and radical ions with water and hydrogen sulfide
items.abstract: Guiding the selection of modern density functional approximations (DFAs) for intermolecular interactions requires diverse benchmark assessments. This work reports the development of a new test set of 86 binary complexes formed between either H 2 O or H 2 S and 31 selected partner species, comprising 15 neutral closed-shell molecules, 7 neutral radicals, 4 closed-shell anions, 2 closed-shell cations, and 3 cation radicals. The radical complexes are susceptible to delocalization error, while the interaction strengths span weak to very strong. Benchmark results are obtained at the coupled cluster singles, doubles and perturbative triples, CCSD(T), level, extrapolated towards the complete basis set limit from augmented triple and quadruple zeta basis calculations. This data is used to assess 17 different density functionals, spanning rungs 2 through 5 of Jacob’s Ladder. In common with other benchmarks, we find that the best functional on each higher rung of Jacob’s Ladder improves over the rung below, consistent with the potential to reduce the delocalization error. Only one functional, the ωB97M(2) double hybrid, achieves an RMS error of less than 1 kcal/mol. The best-performing hybrid is the recently introduced COACH functional, which has an RMS error just below 2 kcal/mol, while the best-performing meta-GGA and GGA have RMS errors above 3 and 4 kcal/mol respectively. These errors are dominated by the complexes that involve radical ions or neutral radicals. While the best-performing functionals are useful, these results indicate that further progress is still needed to address the delocalization error in intermolecular interactions.
items.authors: Rebecca Tomann, Partha P. Bera, Martin Head-Gordon
items.title_zh: 86种中性、离子、自由基及自由基离子与水和硫化氢的相互作用基准数据集
items.summary_zh: 本研究开发了一个新的测试集，包含86个二元复合物，这些复合物由水（H₂O）或硫化氢（H₂S）与31种选择的伙伴物种形成，包括15种中性闭壳层分子、7种中性自由基、4种闭壳层阴离子、2种闭壳层阳离子和3种阳离子自由基。自由基复合物易受去局域化误差影响，且相互作用强度从弱到非常强不等。基准结果在耦合簇单、双和微扰三重态（CCSD(T)）水平上获得，并通过增强的三重和四重ζ基组计算向完整基组极限外推。该数据用于评估17种不同的密度泛函，涵盖雅各布阶梯的第2至第5级。结果显示，每个更高阶梯的最佳泛函在降低去局域化误差方面优于下一级。只有ωB97M(2)双杂化泛函的均方根误差（RMS）低于1 kcal/mol，而新近引入的COACH泛函表现最佳，RMS误差略低于2 kcal/mol，最佳的meta-GGA和GGA泛函的RMS误差分别超过3和4 kcal/mol。

items.title: Redox-Metered Paired Electrolysis: A Strategy for Comprehensive Deaminative C(sp3)–C(sp2) Cross-Coupling
items.abstract: Interfacing transition metal catalysts with radical intermediates is a powerful paradigm for organic synthesis; however, it often requires the precise synchronization of independent catalytic cycles, and this requirement can limit scope and generality. We report a novel electrochemical strategy, which we term “redox-metered paired electrolysis,” in which the formation of a radical precursor in situ gates the rate of activation of its intended partner, thus promoting efficient cross-coupling across diverse substrate classes. We apply this strategy to the deaminative C(sp3)–C(sp2) cross-coupling of primary alkyl amines and aryl electrophiles, facilitated by the design of a bench-stable, dihydropyridine activating group. Notably, our redox-metered approach enables the cross-coupling of four categories of amines with five classes of aryl electrophiles—triflates, chlorides, bromides, iodides, and activated carboxylic acids—all under one unified set of conditions. Nineteen total pairs of amine and aryl electrophile classes are demonstrated to undergo catalytic cross-coupling ( 75 examples), including seven that have not been reported previously. These novel pairs include elusive, yet valuable bond formations, such as the deaminative cross-coupling of phenol-derived aryl triflates with amines and the coupling of aryl halides with α-amino acids. Time course analysis supports the proposed mechanism and reveals design principles for future applications of this strategy.
items.authors: Emma N. George, Mariah C. Castillo, Johnny Z. Wang, Chiyoung Ahn, Colin A. Gould
items.title_zh: 红氧计量配对电解：全面的去氨基C(sp3)–C(sp2)交叉偶联策略
items.summary_zh: 将过渡金属催化剂与自由基中间体相结合是一种强大的有机合成范式，但通常需要独立催化循环的精确同步，这限制了其适用范围和普遍性。我们报告了一种新颖的电化学策略，称为“红氧计量配对电解”，通过原位生成自由基前体来调控其目标反应物的活化速率，从而促进不同底物类别之间的高效交叉偶联。我们将此策略应用于初级烷基胺与芳基电亲体的去氨基C(sp3)–C(sp2)交叉偶联，设计了一种稳定的二氢吡啶活化基团。值得注意的是，我们的红氧计量方法使四类胺与五类芳基电亲体（包括三氟甲磺酸酯、氯、溴、碘和活化羧酸）在统一条件下实现交叉偶联。共展示了19对胺和芳基电亲体类别的催化交叉偶联（75个实例），其中7个为首次报道。这些新颖的配对包括难以获得但有价值的键形成，如酚衍生芳基三氟甲磺酸酯与胺的去氨基交叉偶联及芳基卤化物与α-氨基酸的偶联。时间过程分析支持了这一提议。

items.title: Molecular Origins of Site-Specific CO2 Absorption in Hydrated Deep Eutectic Solvents
items.abstract: Deep eutectic solvents (DESs) have emerged as promising candidates for CO 2 capture because of their highly tunable structures and CO 2 absorption capacities. However, their behavior under practical operating conditions remains poorly understood. In particular, the effect of water on DES structure and their CO 2 absorption capacity remains unclear. In this work, we use free energy perturbation (FEP) and molecular simulations to determine the CO 2 absorption capacities and transport properties of hydrated hydrophilic and hydrophobic DESs. Our results show that increasing water concentration decreases viscosity but also makes CO 2 solvation less favorable in both DESs, revealing a trade-off between transport properties and CO 2 absorption capacity. This trade-off is more favorable for the hydrophobic DES, which shows a substantial reduction in viscosity while maintaining a negative CO 2 solvation free energy. In contrast, the solvation free energy of the hydrophilic DES increases more substantially, becoming positive at 15 wt% H 2 O. Structural analysis reveals that these differences arise from distinct hydration and CO 2 solvation mechanisms in the two DESs. In the hydrophilic DES, CO 2 preferentially localizes around the Br – anion under dry conditions. Upon hydration, water blocks the anionic site, and the preferred CO 2 solvation site shifts to the cation.
items.authors: Deepak Kumar Panda, Soumik Das, Salman A. Khan
items.title_zh: 水合深共熔溶剂中CO2选择性吸收的分子起源
items.summary_zh: 深共熔溶剂（DESs）因其可调结构和CO2吸收能力而成为捕集CO2的有前景候选者。然而，它们在实际操作条件下的行为仍不清楚，尤其是水对DES结构及其CO2吸收能力的影响。本研究采用自由能扰动（FEP）和分子模拟方法，确定了水合亲水性和疏水性DES的CO2吸收能力和传输特性。结果表明，增加水浓度降低了粘度，但也使得CO2的溶剂化在两种DES中变得不太有利，显示出传输特性与CO2吸收能力之间的权衡。疏水性DES的这种权衡更为有利，其粘度显著降低，同时保持负的CO2溶剂化自由能。相反，亲水性DES的溶剂化自由能显著增加，在15 wt% H2O时变为正值。结构分析表明，这些差异源于两种DES中不同的水合和CO2溶剂化机制。

items.title: Transport-guided intensification of plasma activation spray for scalable and tunable water treatment
items.abstract: Interaction of cold plasma with aqueous media underpins emerging technologies in water treatment, chemical conversion, and biomedicine, yet scalable plasma-liquid activation remains limited by inefficient gas-liquid mass transfer and rapid reactive-species decay. This study reports a droplet-based plasma activation spray (PAS) reactor and establishes transport-guided design principles for intensifying reactive oxygen and nitrogen species (RONS) capture. Through systematic variation in spray-nozzle size, chamber geometry, and gas flow, we identify regimes governing the magnitude and composition of plasma activation. Smaller droplets (∼342 µm) favored reactive nitrogen species uptake through increased interfacial area, whereas larger droplets (∼1.3 mm) accumulated hydrogen peroxide through bulk-phase retention. Larger chambers extended droplet flight time and enhanced bulk accumulation, while positioning electrodes near the liquid interface minimized short-lived species transport losses. Spatial repositioning of multiple needles further improved the plasma activation by covering inactive zones. These design principles, validated in scaled PAS systems, achieved peak energy yields ( 1.84 mmol/MJ at liter-scale) and enabled rapid antibiotic degradation and superior ≥ 5-log microbial inactivation, bridging the gap between plasma science and large-scale environmental application. The results position PAS as a tunable and scalable platform, providing a robust engineering framework that couples plasma physics with droplet hydrodynamics for high-throughput water activation.
items.authors: Hon Man Luk, Deepak Panchal, Qiuyun Lu, Siyu Chen, Xuehua Zhang
items.title_zh: 基于传输引导的等离子体激活喷雾水处理技术
items.summary_zh: 冷等离子体与水相介质的相互作用是水处理、化学转化和生物医学等新兴技术的基础，但可扩展的等离子体-液体激活受到气-液传质效率低和反应物种快速衰减的限制。本研究报告了一种基于液滴的等离子体激活喷雾（PAS）反应器，并建立了传输引导设计原则以增强活性氧和氮物种（RONS）的捕获。通过系统变化喷嘴尺寸、腔体几何形状和气体流动，我们识别了影响等离子体激活强度和组成的机制。较小的液滴（∼342 µm）通过增加界面面积促进了活性氮物种的吸收，而较大的液滴（∼1.3 mm）则通过体相保留积累了过氧化氢。较大的腔体延长了液滴飞行时间并增强了体相积累，同时将电极靠近液体界面以最小化短寿命物种的传输损失。多个针头的空间重新定位进一步改善了等离子体激活，覆盖了无效区域。这些设计原则在扩展的PAS系统中得到了验证，实现了峰值能量产率（1.84 mmol/MJ，升级规模），并促进了快速抗生素降解和优越的≥5-log微生物灭活，缩小了等离子体科学与大规模环境应用之间的差距。

items.title: Hyperlocal Sensing and Inverse Modeling Reveal Community Impacts of Urban Air Pollutant Emissions
items.abstract: Addressing urban air pollution requires identifying, quantifying, and mitigating emission sources, yet bottom-up inventories often lack fine spatiotemporal precision and rarely capture unpermitted or informally operated sources. We combine dense mobile and fixed-site measurements in a Bayesian inverse modeling framework to produce hourly, hyperlocal black carbon (BC) emission maps (150 m × 150 m) that reveal how and where key sources are underrepresented. In West Oakland, CA — an overburdened community near major freight infrastructure — our approach identifies underestimated and unaccounted emission sources, increasing estimated BC emissions by ~33%. These corrections quadruple the contribution of neighborhood and port-related sources to population-weighted exposures (from 5 to 20%), disproportionately affecting low-income neighborhoods adjacent to freight corridors. Our results demonstrate that combining dense observational data with inverse modeling enables detection and quantification of overlooked emissions, supporting targeted intervention. Sensitivity analyses indicate similar performance with a substantially reduced fixed-site network (~10 monitors; ~1 site / km 2 , compared with 6.7 sites/km 2 in the full campaign), paired with time-averaged mobile maps, supporting applicability in data-limited urban settings.
items.authors: Chirag Manchanda, Ronald Cohen, Ramon Alvarez, Tammy Thompson, Maria Harris, Alexander Turner
items.title_zh: 超本地感知与反演建模揭示城市空气污染排放的社区影响
items.summary_zh: 应对城市空气污染需要识别、量化和减轻排放源，但自下而上的清单往往缺乏精细的时空精度，且很少捕捉到未获许可或非正式运营的源。我们结合密集的移动和固定站点测量，在贝叶斯反演建模框架中生成每小时的超本地黑碳（BC）排放地图（150 m × 150 m），揭示关键源的低估情况。在加州西奥克兰——一个靠近主要货运基础设施的过度负担社区——我们的方法识别出被低估和未考虑的排放源，使估计的BC排放增加约33%。这些修正使邻里和港口相关源对加权人口暴露的贡献增加四倍（从5%增至20%），对临近货运走廊的低收入社区影响尤为显著。我们的结果表明，结合密集观测数据与反演建模能够检测和量化被忽视的排放，支持有针对性的干预。敏感性分析表明，使用显著减少的固定站点网络（约10个监测器；约1个站点/km²，与完整项目的6.7个站点/km²相比）与时间平均的移动地图结合，仍能实现类似的效果，支持在数据有限的城市环境中的适用性。

items.title: Plasma Protein Binding Prediction under Scaffold Split: Tree Models, ChemBERTa, Graph Networks, and Late Fusion
items.abstract: From idea generation to testing, drug discovery is a lengthy and expensive process. Rather than chasing all of their molecule ideas, scientists prioritize certain molecules that are more likely to be successful, from synthesis to safety to therapeutic use. Machine learning and AI enable researchers to narrow their candidate choices by predicting important properties such as ADMET (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion, and Toxicity). This study uses the Plasma Protein Binding (PPB) dataset from DeepChem’s MoleculeNet, with several graph neural networks (GNNs), ChemBERTa (a language model for SMILES strings of molecules), and fusions of these models. The performance of these neural models is compared against two standard tree-based models: Random Forest (RF) and XGBoost. Instead of random splitting of the dataset, this study evaluates the models based on scaffold splitting that separates molecules by the Bemis–Murcko scaffold and puts the entire group into only the training, validation, or test set. This study demonstrates that for the PPB dataset, GNNs and ChemBERTa models perform better than the tree models. On a mean basis, the fusion models perform better than the individual GNNs or ChemBERTa-only models. Random splitting on the RF model exhibits a better R2 score than on a scaffold-split dataset. Because under scaffold splitting the model predicts on unseen cores, the task becomes more difficult than under regular random splitting.
items.authors: Pradyumna Kumar Pradhan
items.title_zh: 基于支架分割的血浆蛋白结合预测：树模型与图神经网络
items.summary_zh: 药物发现是一个漫长且昂贵的过程，科学家通过机器学习和人工智能优先选择更有可能成功的分子。本研究使用DeepChem的MoleculeNet中的血浆蛋白结合（PPB）数据集，结合多种图神经网络（GNNs）和ChemBERTa模型（针对分子的SMILES字符串的语言模型），并对这些模型进行融合。研究将这些神经模型的表现与随机森林（RF）和XGBoost等标准树模型进行比较。采用支架分割方法，将分子按Bemis–Murcko支架分开，确保整个组仅进入训练、验证或测试集。结果表明，GNNs和ChemBERTa模型在PPB数据集上的表现优于树模型，融合模型的平均表现也优于单独的GNNs或ChemBERTa模型。随机分割的RF模型在R2评分上优于支架分割数据集。

items.title: Performance of Highly Coarse-Grained Chain Models with Extremal Measures for a Configuration-Dependent Hydrodynamic Diameter in Rheological Flow Fields
items.abstract: In the presence of fluctuating hydrodynamic interactions (HI), coarse-grained beadspring models are known to show large deviations in rheological predictions relative to finely resolved chain models. In a recent study, we formulated a modified bead-spring approach where the bead hydrodynamic diameter increases proportionally to the mean spring stretch. Significant improvements were observed in the resulting predictions for rheological flow fields for models with many springs. In the new approach, a balanced accuracy across flow types was obtained with the harmonic mean strategy to obtain the mean stretch. In this study, we explore the limits of this approach with highly coarse-grained models consisting of very few springs. Additionally, we test the behavior of two extremal measures to set the bead hydrodynamic diameter. Note, due to the computational complexity with HI, minimizing the number of beads is highly preferable for any application. Surprisingly, our results show the validity of the approach for high degrees of coarse-graining up to only 3 springs, even with the extremal measures, particularly for extensional flows. Predictions in shear flows become better with increasing number of springs, with a good agreement observed with 10 springs.
items.authors: Lokesh Yadav, Praphul Kumar, S. V. Sivakrishna, Bharatkumar Sharma, Indranil Saha Dalal
items.title_zh: 极端测量下粗粒链模型在流变场中的表现
items.summary_zh: 在波动的流体动力学相互作用下，粗粒化的珠-弹簧模型与精细解析的链模型相比，流变预测存在较大偏差。我们提出了一种改进的珠-弹簧方法，其中珠的流体动力学直径与平均弹簧拉伸成正比。对于含有多个弹簧的模型，流变流场的预测显著改善。新方法通过调和平均策略获得均匀拉伸，确保在不同流动类型中保持平衡的准确性。本研究探讨了该方法在仅包含少量弹簧的高度粗粒化模型中的局限性，并测试了两种极端测量来设置珠的流体动力学直径。结果表明，即使在极端测量下，该方法在高粗粒化程度下（最多3个弹簧）仍然有效，尤其在拉伸流中表现良好。在剪切流中，随着弹簧数量的增加，预测结果逐渐改善，10个弹簧时达成良好一致性。

items.title: Cationic Selenuranes Enable Direct Linchpin Formation in Arenes
items.abstract: The formation of linchpins is a powerful strategy for increasing molecular complexity. Chalcogenonium salts have become valuable intermediates for molecular diversification, owing to their exceptional chemoselectivity in arene C–H functionalization and a synthetic versatility comparable to that of halides and pseudohalides. Sulfonium group introduction through an isohypsic process from S(IV) precursors requires activation with strong acids or anhydrides. Here, we report the direct synthesis of selenonium salts from bench-stable Se(III) cationic selenuranes using a simple dump-and-stir protocol. The transformation proceeds under air at ambient temperature and requires no exogenous activators. Mechanistic investigations reveal high sensitivity to electronic effects (ρ = −10), whereas site selectivity is determined by the rate-limiting deprotonation step (kH/kD = 2.3). The method is scalable to 10.0 mmol ( 6.2 g) and provides direct access to selenonium salts derived from complex molecules. The resulting selenonium salts serve as versatile linchpins for photochemical, nucleophilic, and transition-metal-catalyzed transformations, enabling late-stage molecular diversification.
items.authors: Kirill Zhiliaev, Till Schreyer, Mihai V. Popescu, Javier Mateos
items.title_zh: 阳离子硒氨盐实现芳烃中直接连接体的形成
items.summary_zh: 连接体的形成是一种有效增加分子复杂性的策略。由于其在芳烃C–H功能化中的优异化学选择性，硫族阳离子盐已成为分子多样化的重要中间体。通过从S(IV)前体的等高过程引入磺基团需要强酸或酸酐的激活。本文报道了一种从稳定的Se(III)阳离子硒氨盐直接合成硒氨盐的方法，采用简单的倾倒搅拌协议。该转化在常温下的空气中进行，无需外源激活剂。机理研究显示对电子效应高度敏感（ρ = −10），而位点选择性由速率限制的去质子化步骤决定（kH/kD = 2.3）。该方法可扩展至10.0 mmol（6.2 g），并直接获得源自复杂分子的硒氨盐。所得硒氨盐可作为多功能连接体，支持光化学、亲核和过渡金属催化转化，实现后期分子多样化。

items.title: Microphase Separation and Water Accessibility in Crosslinked Polyurethanes
items.abstract: Polyurethane materials are among the most widely used synthetic polymers, yet the atomic-scale structural organisation governing their macroscopic properties remains largely elusive. Despite decades of study, the chain organisation of hard and soft domains in polyurethane remains poorly understood because experimental techniques cannot resolve chain packing and intermolecular interactions at atomistic resolution. Here we combine Monte Carlo-based downsampling of chain length distributions fitted to experimental data with an iterative crosslinking protocol coupled to molecular dynamics relaxation to generate fully atomistic models of heterogeneous polymers with varying crosslinking degrees, using toluene diisocyanate (TDI) and propoxylated glycerol-based polyurethane as a model system. The resulting models reproduce available experimental thermodynamic and structural data, and spontaneously develop microphase separated morphologies consistent with experimental observations. The simulations reveal that hard segment aggregation is a major organisational factor driving microphase separation. Within hard domains, interchain NH· · ·O=C hydrogen bonds dominate cohesive interactions, while atomistic resolution reveals aromatic packing motifs consistent with π-π interactions between aromatic rings in both parallel and perpendicular geometries. At the polyurethane-water interface, urea and amine groups are the most solvent-exposed and retain well-defined hydration shells, whereas urethane linkages remain comparatively shielded. Together, these results provide an atomistic account of hard domain formation and microphase separation in polyurethane, and establish how this morphology governs the accessibility of urethane bonds to catalytic cleavage. The approach provides a framework for investigating structure-property relationships in heterogeneous amorphous polymer systems, with potential applications ranging from enzymatic degradation to materials design.
items.authors: Alexandre V. Pinto, Pedro A. Fernandes, Maria J. Ramos
items.title_zh: 交联聚氨酯的微相分离与水的可及性
items.summary_zh: 聚氨酯材料是最广泛使用的合成聚合物之一，但其原子级结构组织对宏观性质的影响仍不清楚。尽管经过数十年的研究，聚氨酯中硬域和软域的链组织仍不明了，因为实验技术无法在原子分辨率下解析链的堆积和分子间相互作用。本文结合基于蒙特卡罗的链长分布下采样与分子动力学松弛的迭代交联协议，生成具有不同交联度的异质聚合物的全原子模型，采用甲苯二异氰酸酯（TDI）和丙氧基甘油基聚氨酯作为模型系统。结果模型再现了现有的热力学和结构数据，并自发发展出与实验观察一致的微相分离形态。模拟结果表明，硬段聚集是驱动微相分离的主要组织因素。在硬域内，链间的NH· · ·O=C氢键主导了内聚相互作用，而原子分辨率揭示了与芳香环之间的π-π相互作用一致的芳香堆积模式。

items.title: Accumulation of enzymes on the lipid-oleosin membarnes
items.abstract: Engineering the spatial organization of proteins offers a powerful strategy for controlling biochemical reactions and material properties in synthetic cells. However, dynamically organizing multiple proteins at the nanometer scale remains challenging. We developed asymmetric lipid–oleosin hybrid vesicles in which engineered oleosin molecules served as membrane-forming scaffolds with two orthogonal conjugation systems. External chemical stimuli rapidly recruited two distinct proteins to individual oleosin molecules, generating persistent nanometer-scale proximity, as demonstrated by single-molecule tracking. In an alditol oxidase–horseradish peroxidase cascade, organization of both enzymes on the same oleosin scaffold enhanced product formation compared with intermolecular membrane recruitment. This localized cascade further drove stimulus-responsive polymerization to form membrane-associated cytoskeleton-like structures, increasing vesicle resistance to hypertonic stress. This programmable membrane scaffold couples external signals with molecular organization, enhanced biochemical reactions, and membrane mechanics, providing a framework for engineering synthetic cells that convert chemical inputs into programmable reactions and material outputs.
items.authors: Masato Suzuki, Rinshi S. Kasai, Koki Kamiya
items.title_zh: 脂质-油蛋白膜上酶的积累研究
items.summary_zh: 工程化蛋白质的空间组织为控制合成细胞中的生化反应和材料特性提供了有效策略。然而，在纳米尺度上动态组织多种蛋白质仍然具有挑战性。我们开发了不对称的脂质-油蛋白混合囊泡，工程化的油蛋白分子作为膜形成支架，具备两种正交结合系统。外部化学刺激迅速将两种不同的蛋白质招募到各自的油蛋白分子上，产生持久的纳米级接近性。通过单分子追踪证明，在醇糖氧化酶-辣根过氧化物酶级联反应中，酶在同一油蛋白支架上的组织相比于分子间膜招募增强了产物形成。该局部级联反应进一步驱动刺激响应聚合，形成膜相关的细胞骨架样结构，提高了囊泡对高渗透压的抵抗力。这种可编程的膜支架将外部信号与分子组织、生化反应和膜力学相结合，为工程合成细胞提供了将化学输入转化为可编程反应和材料输出的框架。

items.title: Finite-Field Second Hyperpolarizability via Adaptive Bayesian Quantum Phase Estimation for Early Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computers: Ground-State Energies Beyond Chemical Accuracy
items.abstract: The static second hyperpolarizability governs third-order nonlinear-optical responses but is difficult to compute by first-principles methods because finite-field extraction requires a fourth-order energy derivative. The resulting error amplification demands sub-µHa ground-state energies, far beyond conventional chemical accuracy. Standard multi-qubit QPE can in principle meet this precision but requires a wide ancilla register, while single-ancilla iterative QPE (IQPE) is limited by a binary-grid quantization floor. We develop an adaptive Bayesian QPE (BQPE) workflow that uses a single ancilla, terminal measurements, and real-time classical feedback to estimate the eigenphase through a continuous posterior rather than a fixed binary grid. For a linear H4 chain in the STO-3G basis, represented by a six-qubit parity Hamiltonian with one ancilla, BQPE reaches a ground-state energy error of ≈ 10−7 Ha at controlled-U depth mmax ≈ 215, about two orders of magnitude below the IQPE floor. Propagated through the finite-field stencil and Richardson extrapolation, these energies recover the second hyperpolarizability within ±10% of the FCI reference over the stable field-strength plateau, whereas IQPE at the same depth fails to do so. These results indicate that grid-free Bayesian phase estimation can make nonlinear-optical properties accessible on early fault-tolerant quantum computers.
items.authors: Katsuki Okuno
items.title_zh: 自适应贝叶斯量子相位估计的有限场二次超极化率研究
items.summary_zh: 静态二次超极化率控制三阶非线性光学响应，但由于有限场提取需要四阶能量导数，导致其难以通过第一性原理计算。所需的亚µHa基态能量超出传统化学精度。标准多量子比特量子相位估计（QPE）理论上可以达到此精度，但需要较大的辅助寄存器，而单辅助量子迭代QPE（IQPE）受限于二进制网格量化。我们开发了一种自适应贝叶斯QPE（BQPE）工作流程，利用单个辅助量子比特、终端测量和实时经典反馈，通过连续后验估计本征相位。对于STO-3G基中的线性H4链，BQPE在控制-U深度mmax ≈ 215时达到约10−7 Ha的基态能量误差，远低于IQPE的限制。通过有限场模板和理查森外推，这些能量在稳定场强区间内恢复了二次超极化率，误差在±10%以内，而同深度的IQPE未能实现。这些结果表明，无网格贝叶斯相位估计可以使早期容错量子计算机上的非线性光学性质变得可及。

items.title: Data-driven strategies for enzyme engineering: From machine learning to protein language models
items.abstract: Enzymes are key biocatalysts that drive diverse biological processes and industrial applications, offering sustainable alternatives to conventional chemical catalysis. However, the enormous enzyme sequence space and the limited functional annotation have created an urgent demand for computational approaches to accelerate enzyme discovery and engineering. Recent advances in computational methods are accelerating enzyme engineering from empirical trial and error toward predictive design. This review summarizes representative computational tools and predictive models in the enzyme engineering workflow, including (1) enzyme data resources, (2) functional enzyme discovery, (3) enzyme property prediction (e.g., kinetics, optimal temperature and PH, solubility, promiscuity, and specificity), (4) de novo enzyme design, and (5) computationally guided enzyme optimization. We further compare current computational strategies, discuss their strengths and limitations in different engineering scenarios, and highlight emerging trends toward foundation models, generative artificial intelligence, multimodal learning, and closed-loop design–build–test–learn platforms.
items.authors: Shaozhen Ding, Peng Wu, Shubo Li, Yuxuan Yang, Han Zhu, Heng Yu
items.title_zh: 数据驱动的酶工程策略：从机器学习到蛋白质语言模型
items.summary_zh: 酶是推动多种生物过程和工业应用的关键生物催化剂，为传统化学催化提供了可持续的替代方案。然而，庞大的酶序列空间和有限的功能注释使得加速酶发现和工程的计算方法需求迫切。近期计算方法的进展正在将酶工程从经验性的试错转向预测性设计。本文总结了酶工程工作流程中的代表性计算工具和预测模型，包括（1）酶数据资源，（2）功能酶发现，（3）酶性质预测（如动力学、最佳温度和pH、溶解度、广谱性和特异性），（4）de novo酶设计，以及（5）计算指导的酶优化。我们进一步比较了当前的计算策略，讨论其在不同工程场景中的优缺点，并强调了基础模型、生成性人工智能、多模态学习和闭环设计-构建-测试-学习平台等新兴趋势。

items.title: Contrastive Reward Based Reinforcement Learning for Goal Directed 3D Molecular Design
items.abstract: Although three-dimensional flow-matching models have become powerful tools for efficient sampling of high-quality 3D molecular structures, reward-based reinforcement learning for flow-matching models is complicated by the absence of a tractable trajectory likelihood for hybrid molecular states comprising categorical features and continuous coordinates. Existing policy-optimization strategies address this difficulty by stochasticizing the generative process or constructing likelihood surrogates, introducing additional approximations. Here, we present ReCoFlow, a novel trajectorylikelihood-free reinforcement learning framework for reward-contrastive post-training of pretrained molecular flow-matching models. Within ReCoFlow, reward-favored molecules provide positive endpoint supervision for the flow-matching model, whereas reward-disfavored molecules are used to construct reference-guided negative targets. Additionally, an anchor loss to an exponential moving average (EMA) reference model constrains the drift of the fine-tuned model. In benchmarking studies including physicochemical property optimization, three-dimensional shape optimization, and pocket-conditioned 3D molecular generation, ReCoFlow consistently improved the performance of flow-matching models over reward-weighted and surrogate-ratio optimization schemes while maintaining high molecular validity. These results suggest that ReCoFlow could be an effective reinforcement-learning strategy for goal-directed molecular design.
items.authors: Bohao Li, Yuedong Yang, Mingyuan Xu, Hongming Chen
items.title_zh: 基于对比奖励的目标导向三维分子设计强化学习
items.summary_zh: 三维流匹配模型已成为高效采样高质量三维分子结构的强大工具，但基于奖励的强化学习因缺乏可处理的混合分子状态轨迹似然而复杂化。现有的策略优化方法通过随机化生成过程或构建似然替代来解决这一难题，带来了额外的近似。本文提出了ReCoFlow，一种新颖的无轨迹似然强化学习框架，用于对预训练分子流匹配模型进行奖励对比后训练。在ReCoFlow中，奖励偏好的分子为流匹配模型提供正向监督，而奖励不偏好的分子用于构建参考引导的负目标。此外，锚损失与指数移动平均（EMA）参考模型相结合，约束了微调模型的漂移。在物理化学性质优化、三维形状优化和口袋条件下的三维分子生成等基准研究中，ReCoFlow在保持高分子有效性的同时，持续提升了流匹配模型的性能，相较于奖励加权和替代比优化方案表现更佳。

items.title: Conformal Prediction and Multi-Ensemble Gradient Boosting for Subtype-Selective Binding Affinity Estimation Across Human Adenosine Receptors
items.abstract: Subtype selectivity across human adenosine GPCRs remains an intractable medicinal chemistry challenge. The four orthosteric binding pockets share over 70% sequence homology across transmembrane helices III, V, VI, and VII. Consequently, standard QSAR models fail prospectively. They suffer from systemic scaffold leakage, overestimating held-out affinity while producing point estimates that lack calibrated error bars. We built an open-source, leak-free computational platform to solve both failure modes. The architecture combines XGBoost gradient boosting with MAPIE Jackknife+ cross-conformal prediction, Random Forest, and LightGBM, trained on 9,589 curated ChEMBL v34 and GPCRdb bioactivity records. Under strict Bemis-Murcko scaffold partitioning (N_train = 6,332; N_test = 1,583), the ensemble achieved an overall R2 of 0.693 and MAE of 0.390 pChEMBL units. On active compounds alone (N_test = 3,771, structural decoys removed), accuracy reached an overall R2 of 0.865 and MAE of 0.314. Per-subtype R2 values reached 0.753 for A1, 0.884 for A2A, 0.912 for A2B, and 0.886 for A3. Conformal intervals delivered 85.80% empirical coverage at a 90% nominal confidence level. Uncertainty quartiles scaled monotonically with absolute prediction error. A GINE graph neural network trained on identical scaffold splits managed only R2 = 0.248 overall, demonstrating that curated physicochemical descriptors decisively outperform deep graph convolutions in low-to-medium data regimes. Twenty-fold Y-randomization confirmed genuine structure-activity relationships, with all permuted R2 values falling below zero (p 0.001). External blind validation on 15 novel GPCRdb ligands yielded a 75% selectivity recall accuracy. TreeSHAP features attributions verified that model decisions follow interpretable electrostatic and steric properties. All source code, curated data splits, model weights, and interactive deployment are publicly available.
items.authors: Utkarsh Patel
items.title_zh: 跨人类腺苷受体的亚型选择性结合亲和力估计研究
items.summary_zh: 人类腺苷GPCRs的亚型选择性仍然是药物化学中的一个难题。四个正位结合口袋在跨膜螺旋III、V、VI和VII中共享超过70%的序列同源性，因此标准的QSAR模型在前瞻性预测中失败，存在系统性框架泄漏，过高估计保留的亲和力，同时产生缺乏校准误差条的点估计。我们构建了一个开源、无泄漏的计算平台，结合了XGBoost梯度提升、MAPIE Jackknife+交叉一致性预测、随机森林和LightGBM，基于9,589个整理的ChEMBL v34和GPCRdb生物活性记录进行训练。在严格的Bemis-Murcko框架划分下（N_train = 6,332; N_test = 1,583），该集成模型整体R2为0.693，MAE为0.390 pChEMBL单位。仅在活性化合物上（N_test = 3,771，去除结构伪像），准确度达到了整体R2为0.865，MAE为0.314。各亚型R2值分别为A1的0.753，A2A的0.884，A2B的0.912，以及A3的0.886。符合区间在90%的名义置信水平下提供了85.80%的经验覆盖率。预测误差的绝对值与不确定性四分位数单调增长。使用相同框架划分训练的GINE图神经网络整体仅实现R2 = 0.248，显示出整理的物理化学描述符的局限性。

items.title: Evolution of primary loops in vitrimers
items.abstract: Covalent adaptable networks (CANs) comprise dynamic covalent bonds that allow topological reconfiguration. While this behavior underlies the reprocessability and recyclability of CANs, its influence on network topology, including defects, remains poorly understood. Prior simulations and indirect experimental studies suggest that dynamic exchange decreases the prevalence of primary loops, but direct experimental quantification has remained elusive. Here we use network disassembly spectrometry (NDS) to directly measure topological evolution during dynamic exchange. Surprisingly, activation of exchange at constant composition reveals two distinct concentration-dependent regimes. At concentrations above ~0.2 M, primary loops decrease upon activating exchange, whereas at lower concentrations, loop content increases, leading to gel-sol transitions. Temperature-dependent experiments and coarse-grained simulations suggest that these trends arise from competing entropic contributions that favor either loop formation or consumption depending on concentration. Changes in topology are accompanied by measurable changes in mechanical properties, demonstrating a direct relationship between network structure and macroscopic behavior. Furthermore, the concentration-dependent transition enables topology-mediated recycling, in which materials reversibly transition between gel and sol states through network rearrangement alone. These results provide the first direct experimental evidence of topology evolution in covalent adaptable networks and establish network topology as a measurable and tunable design parameter in dynamic polymer systems.
items.authors: Emmanuel A. Garcia Villatoro, Sullivan W. Fitz, Jolly Patro, Alexis Martell Monterroza, Jeremiah A. Johnson, Olvera de la Cruz
items.title_zh: 维特聚合物中初级环的演变研究
items.summary_zh: 共价可调网络（CANs）由动态共价键组成，允许拓扑重构。尽管这一特性是CANs可再加工性和可回收性的基础，但其对网络拓扑（包括缺陷）的影响仍不清楚。先前的模拟和间接实验研究表明，动态交换减少了初级环的出现，但直接的实验定量尚未实现。本文采用网络解体光谱法（NDS）直接测量动态交换过程中的拓扑演变。令人惊讶的是，在恒定组成下激活交换时，发现了两个不同的浓度依赖性区域。在浓度高于约0.2 M时，激活交换会减少初级环的数量，而在较低浓度下，环的含量增加，导致凝胶-溶液转变。温度依赖性实验和粗粒度模拟表明，这些趋势源于竞争的熵贡献，取决于浓度而偏向环的形成或消耗。拓扑变化伴随着可测量的机械性质变化，表明网络结构与宏观行为之间存在直接关系。此外，浓度依赖性转变使得拓扑介导的回收成为可能，材料在凝胶和溶液状态之间可逆转变。

items.title: Olympic-patterned pentaboron emitter featuring highly distorted geometry enables efficient solution-processed ultrapure green OLEDs
items.abstract: Efficient, ultrapure green organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs) fabricated via wet processing are crucial for ultrahigh definition displays but remain highly challenging due to the paucity of suitable emitters. Herein, we developed Oly-BN, a novel multipleresonance thermally activated delayed fluorescence (MR-TADF) emitter featuring a distinct Olympic-patterned boron-distribution. The zigzag doped heteroatom polycyclic aromatic framework enables near-degenerate singlet/triplet excited states. Integrating para-N-π-B motifs helps regulate the triplet manifold and emission color point, enabling energetically accessible higher lying triplet excited states with enhanced spinorbit coupling, while also suppressing low-frequency structural relaxation and modulating the optical bandgap. Oly-BN in toluene exhibits vivid green emission at 522 nm with a narrow full width at half maximum (FWHM) of 17 nm, a photoluminescence quantum yield of 95%, and a fast reverse intersystem crossing rate constant of 6.9×106 s−1. Additionally, its highly twisted conformation weakens intermolecular interactions and favors bright, solid-state emission. The nonsensitized solution-processed OLEDs deliver ultrapure green electroluminescence with a CIEy value up to 0.73, and achieves an optimized maximum external quantum efficiency of 39.4%, which remains high at 29.9% at 1000 cd m-2. This work not only provides a promising highly saturated green emitter for solution-processed OLEDs but also demonstrates the importance of precisely integrating heteroatoms in modulating photophysical properties of MR-TADF emitters.
items.authors: Xin Xiong, Rajat Walia, Dongyang Chen, Cheng-Xi Li, Xiao-Chun Fan, Xian-Kai Chen
items.title_zh: 奥林匹克图案五硼发射体实现高效超纯绿色OLED
items.summary_zh: 高效的超纯绿色有机发光二极管（OLED）对于超高清显示至关重要，但由于合适发射体的匮乏，仍然面临挑战。本文开发了Oly-BN，一种新型的多重共振热激活延迟荧光（MR-TADF）发射体，具有独特的奥林匹克图案硼分布。锯齿形掺杂异原子多环芳烃框架使得单重态/三重态激发态近简并。整合对-N-π-B基元有助于调节三重态能级和发射颜色点，促进能量可达的高能三重态激发态，并增强自旋-轨道耦合，同时抑制低频结构弛豫并调节光学带隙。Oly-BN在甲苯中表现出522 nm的鲜艳绿色发射，半高宽（FWHM）为17 nm，光致发光量子产率为95%，快速反向系综交叉速率常数为6.9×10^6 s−1。此外，其高度扭曲的构象减弱了分子间相互作用，促进了明亮的固态发射。非敏化的溶液处理OLED实现了超纯绿色电致发光，CIEy值高达0.73，优化的最大外量子效率为39.4%，在1000 cd m-2时仍保持29.9%的高效率。

items.title: Catalytic Phosphorus-Based Hydrogen Atom
items.abstract: We report the first catalytic phosphorus-based hydrogen atom transfer system. Using an iridium photocatalyst and 10 mol% diphenylphosphine sulfide, we achieve decarboxylative reduction of diverse carboxylic acids—including peptides and pharmaceuticals—to C–H products in up to 95% yield, without stoichiometric reductants. Mechanistic studies reveal an unprecedented anionic relay: a phosphoryl radical is reduced to a phosphinoyl anion, which upon protonation regenerates the P–H catalyst. This work establishes catalytic turnover in phosphorus-based HAT and identifies a new elementary step in main-group radical chemistry.
items.authors: Pratik Avinash, Kayla Merrigan, Bartosz Bieszczad
items.title_zh: 催化磷基氢原子转移系统研究
items.summary_zh: 我们报道了首个催化磷基氢原子转移系统。采用铱光催化剂和10 mol%的二苯基磷硫化物，我们实现了多种羧酸（包括肽类和药物）的脱羧还原，C–H产物的产率高达95%，且无需化学计量还原剂。机理研究揭示了一种前所未有的阴离子中继：磷酰自由基被还原为磷酰阴离子，随后在质子化后再生P–H催化剂。这项工作确立了磷基氢原子转移的催化循环，并识别出主族自由基化学中的一个新基本步骤。

items.title: Vicem: Automating Molecular Mechanics Modeling of Solvation Dynamics with Applications to Time-Resolved X-ray Scattering
items.abstract: Time-resolved X-ray solution scattering (trXSS) probes molecular-scale structural dynamics in solution, but its interpretation requires efficient computational methodologies and models for assessing how changes in solute structure and charge distribution affect the surrounding solvent shell and the resulting scattering signal. We present VICEM, an OpenMM/ASE-based software suite for constructing solvated molecular models, running molecular dynamics simulations, inspecting and analyzing the resulting trajectories, while exposing solute geometry, partial charges, Lennard–Jones parameters, and bonded terms as editable variables for model refinement. VICEM includes an approximate restrained-solute model designed for rapid solvent-shell sampling around prescribed solute geometries, together with utilities for correcting the potential energy along selected intramolecular coordinates. We benchmark the restrained model against established force fields for 244 systems comprising neutral organic molecules, charged organic solutes, and transition-metal complexes. Across 5018 solute-water radial distribution functions, the effect of restraining the solute structure on the solvent shell is generally comparable to differences between established flexible force fields, and diagnostic cases are scrutinized to identify when reference geometry, nonbonded assignment, or suppressed solute flexibility controls the solvent response. For a prototypical iron complex, VICEM is used to scan candidate geometries and quantify the effect of the structure on solvent-shell radial distribution functions and the corresponding scattering signal, showing how VICEM can be used to tune molecular models for structural refinement. VICEM is therefore shown to provide a platform for reproducible solvent-shell modeling and targeted force-field refinement with particular focus on trXSS analysis.
items.authors: A. O. Dohn, D. Llorena Prieto, E. Selenius, M. Haubro, K. Haldrup, K. B. Møller
items.title_zh: Vicem：自动化分子力学建模溶剂动力学的应用研究
items.summary_zh: 时间分辨X射线溶液散射（trXSS）探测溶液中分子尺度的结构动态，但其解释需要高效的计算方法和模型，以评估溶质结构和电荷分布变化如何影响周围溶剂壳及其散射信号。我们提出了VICEM，一个基于OpenMM/ASE的软件套件，用于构建溶剂化分子模型、运行分子动力学模拟、检查和分析结果轨迹，同时将溶质几何形状、部分电荷、Lennard-Jones参数和键合项作为可编辑变量以进行模型优化。VICEM包括一个近似的限制溶质模型，旨在快速采样给定溶质几何形状周围的溶剂壳，并提供用于沿选定分子内坐标校正势能的工具。我们对244个系统的限制模型进行了基准测试，涵盖中性有机分子、带电有机溶质和过渡金属络合物。5018个溶质-水径向分布函数的结果表明，限制溶质结构对溶剂壳的影响通常与已建立的柔性力场之间的差异相当。

items.title: The Gated Quantum Resonator: a reduced-representation Hamiltonian–network framework for gated driven–dissipative quantum systems
items.abstract: High-dimensional driven–dissipative systems are often described either microscopically or through reduced models whose relation to the underlying dynamics is unclear. Originally motivated by geometrygated catalytic and enzymatic dynamics, the construction is developed here independently of any particular molecular application. We formulate the Gated Quantum Resonator (GQR) as a controlled reducedrepresentation framework in which selected coherent coordinates are modulated by structural or environmental gates. The retained coordinates are supplied by an upstream modelling step; no projection or truncation algorithm is introduced. From a gate-dependent Hamiltonian we develop complementary mode, network and port–Hamiltonian representations, distinguishing exact preservation properties from phenomenological closures requiring independent validation. Open-system dynamics are introduced through a GKSL generator. For the linear lossless sector, the specified mechanical–network map exactly preserves normal-mode frequencies and modal eigenspaces, while matched input–output equality is a consistency property by construction. An exactly solvable lossy three-state bridge then shows that a previously proposed coupling–loss–dephasing coordinate does not select a universal microscopic transport optimum. The framework therefore treats reduced models as generators of explicit mechanistic hypotheses whose spectral, transport and geometric consequences can be tested, narrowed or rejected by independent physical evidence.
items.authors: James R F SUTTON
items.title_zh: 门控量子谐振器：门控驱动耗散量子系统的简化哈密顿网络框架
items.summary_zh: 高维驱动耗散系统通常通过微观描述或简化模型进行表述，但其与基础动力学的关系不明确。本文独立于特定分子应用，提出了门控量子谐振器（GQR）作为一种受控的简化表示框架，其中选定的相干坐标受到结构或环境门的调制。保留的坐标由上游建模步骤提供，未引入投影或截断算法。我们从门依赖的哈密顿量出发，发展了互补的模式、网络和端口哈密顿表示，区分了精确保持特性与需要独立验证的现象学闭合。通过GKSL生成器引入开放系统动力学。在无损线性部分，指定的机械网络映射精确保持正常模式频率和模态特征空间，而匹配的输入输出等式是构造上的一致性特性。一个可精确求解的有损三态桥接示例表明，先前提出的耦合-损耗-去相干坐标并未选择出普遍的微观传输最优解。因此，该框架将简化模型视为显式机制假设的生成器。

items.title: TAMCA: Time-Aware Multi-Scale Convolutional Attention for Multi-Class Industrial Anomaly Detection
items.abstract: In multi-class industrial anomaly detection, latent diffusion models commonly use the same attention and receptive-field configuration across all noise stages. This stage-invariant design makes it difficult to balance global structure recovery at high noise levels with local detail preservation at low noise levels, which may lead to structural drift, over-smoothing, and unstable anomaly maps. To address this issue, we propose TAMCA, a time-aware multi-scale convolutional attention framework for diffusion-based anomaly detection. In TAMCA, a Multi-Scale Convolutional Attention module (MSCA) is embedded into the denoising network to jointly model local textures and long-range contextual dependencies through local depthwise convolution and decomposed large-kernel convolution. To further adapt contextual modeling to different denoising stages, diffusion timestep embeddings are mapped into gating coefficients, which selectively regulate the contribution of the large-kernel context branch according to the noise level. During inference, Diffusion-aware Consistency Ensembling (DiCE) estimates multi-view reliability through median consensus and performs reliability-weighted fusion to suppress view-specific false responses. Experiments on MVTec-AD and VisA show that TAMCA achieves pixel-level AUROC values of 97.2% and 97.0%, respectively, with consistent improvements in pixel-level AP, F1max, and PRO.
items.authors: Xiaoli Li, Yantong Guan, Jin Jiang, Maozhang Ye, Huangping Yan, Chentao Zhang

items.title: Nonfatal Burden of Disease and Risk-Attributable Burden in Romania, 1990 to 2023: A Secondary Analysis of Global Burden of Disease 2023 Estimates
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: We assessed changes in nonfatal disease burden and risk attribution in Romania between 1990 and 2023. Methods: We analysed Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2023 estimates of years lived with disability (YLDs), related nonfatal measures and risk attribution for 199 causes and 61 risks, with seventeen comparator locations. Results: The age-standardised YLD rate changed by −4.1% (95% uncertainty interval [UI] −10.1 to 1.3), and total YLDs by −3.9% (95% UI −9.2 to 0.7). Both intervals included zero. The crude rate rose by 17.0%. The population size and age structure components of the decomposition were approximately −552,000 and +545,000 YLDs; their uncertainty was not estimated. Healthy life expectancy increased by 5.2 years. Its difference from life expectancy rose from 9.2 to 10.2 years, without an uncertainty interval for this derived change. Low-back pain remained the leading level 3 cause. Anxiety disorders increased by 41.7% (95% UI 4.5 to 101.8) and ranked second by point estimate; rank uncertainty was not estimated. The joint risk-attributable fraction fell from 31.2% to 28.3%. Conclusions: Romania had more disability per inhabitant and a larger share at older ages in 2023. Musculoskeletal disorders remained the main source of nonfatal burden, while anxiety disorders and diabetes increased.
items.authors: Mihaela Hostiuc, Vlad-Adrian Afrasanie, Octavian Andronic, Alina-Ioana Forray, Sorin Hostiuc, Andreea-Iuliana Ionescu

items.title: FastSurfer-Based Brain Morphometry and Machine-Learning Classification Across the Alzheimer’s Disease Spectrum
items.abstract: Background: This study aimed to quantitatively assess structural changes in the hippocampus, amygdala, entorhinal cortex, lateral ventricles, precuneus, and posterior cingulate using deep-learning-based FastSurfer morphometry and evaluate their contribution to classification across the Alzheimer’s disease (AD) spectrum. Methods: Three-dimensional T1-weighted MRI data from the AD Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) were analyzed using FastSurfer. The study included 791 participants (425 female and 366 male): 365 cognitively normal (CN), 273 with mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and 153 with AD. Morphometric measures included hippocampal and amygdala volumes, lateral ventricular volume, entorhinal cortical thickness and surface area, and precuneus and posterior cingulate thickness and folding index. Volumetric measures were normalized to estimated total intracranial volume (eTIV). Principal morphometric comparisons were additionally adjusted for age, sex, and education. Six machine-learning classifiers were evaluated using participant-level training (n = 632) and held-out test (n = 159) sets, with an additional MMSE-ablation analysis. Results: Hippocampal and amygdala volumes were significantly lower and lateral ventricular volume was significantly higher in AD than in CN (all p 0.001), with these differences persisting after eTIV normalization and remaining significant after adjustment for age, sex, and education (all adjusted p 0.001). MCI generally showed intermediate volumetric values between CN and AD. Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) scores correlated positively with total hippocampal (r = 0.495) and amygdala (r = 0.462) volumes and negatively with lateral ventricular volume (r = −0.256) (all p 0.001). For three-class CN/MCI/AD classification, Logistic Regression with ElasticNet achieved a mean macro-F1 score of 0.706 ± 0.017 in five-fold cross-validation and a held-out macro-F1 score of 0.705 with MMSE included. Excluding MMSE reduced the held-out macro-F1 score to 0.531 and ROC-AUC to 0.735, compared with 0.857 when MMSE was included. Performance was higher for binary CN-versus-AD classification, with a held-out test macro-F1 score of 0.919 and ROC-AUC of 0.990. Conclusions: FastSurfer-based morphometry demonstrated medial temporal atrophy and lateral ventricular enlargement across the CN–MCI–AD spectrum, with the principal volumetric differences remaining robust after adjustment for age, sex, and education. The intermediate morphometric profile of MCI and the associations between medial temporal volumes and cognitive performance support the relevance of these structural measures. Machine-learning performance improved substantially when MMSE was incorporated, indicating that the combined models reflect integrated morphometric, demographic, genetic, and cognitive information rather than morphometry alone. External validation in independent cohorts is required before clinical application.
items.authors: Sinem Nur Altun, Hurriyet Cetinok

items.title: Improving Adversarial Transferability in No-Reference Image Quality Assessment via Consensus-Guided Distillation and Local Perceptual Attack
items.abstract: No-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA) metrics are widely used to evaluate and train image and video processing algorithms, but the growing reliance on deep neural networks makes these metrics vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Among such attacks, transferable black-box methods are particularly relevant in real-world scenarios where the attacker cannot interact with the target metric to generate adversarial examples and must rely on a substitute white-box model. In this paper, we examine adversarial transferability across modern NR-IQA metrics and introduce two complementary techniques, Consensus-Guided Distillation (CGD) and Local Perceptual Attack (LPA), which together form a two-stage transferable attack pipeline. CGD distills an ensemble of NR-IQA metrics into a single white-box substitute, excluding training samples for which the teacher metrics show high disagreement, thereby improving transferability and reducing the computational cost of both training and attack generation. LPA optimizes adversarial examples over random multi-scale image partitions, encouraging perturbations to exploit local distortion-sensitive features shared across NR-IQA metrics. Experiments using 15 NR-IQA metrics and four datasets show that distillation substantially improves black-box transferability, while LPA consistently outperforms existing transferable attacks against NR-IQA metrics, both in increasing predicted quality scores and in reducing correlations with subjective quality scores. We also find that attack transferability depends strongly on the type of distortions present in the image, indicating that adversarial perturbations can conceal certain visual degradations from NR-IQA metrics.
items.authors: Andrey Dolgolenko, Georgii Bychkov, Dmitriy Vatolin

items.title: A Multi-Sensor Fusion-Based Remaining Useful Life Prediction Model for UAV Engines
items.abstract: With the widespread application of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) across various domains, the reliability and lifespan prediction of their core power units—the engines—has become a critical research focus. This study addresses the degradation characteristics of UAV engines under complex operating conditions, including high temperature, high pressure, high rotational speed, and severe vibration, and proposes a remaining useful life (RUL) prediction model based on multi-sensor data fusion. First, a multi-sensor data acquisition platform for UAV engines was established, enabling synchronized collection of multi-dimensional parameters across the entire life cycle, including thrust, torque, temperature, vibration, current, and voltage. Subsequently, a multi-sensor fusion-based RUL prediction model for UAV engines was developed, employing an attention-guided multi-scale residual convolution module to extract local multi-scale degradation features, and integrating a residual-attention Transformer to enhance the modeling of long-sequence dependencies. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms conventional CNN, RNN, and fusion models in terms of RMSE, R2, and Score metrics, significantly improving the accuracy and training stability of UAV engine lifespan prediction. This study provides both data support and methodological innovation for predictive maintenance of UAV engines, contributing to enhanced flight safety and mission assurance.
items.authors: Peng He, Wenwen Yu, Shenshen Deng, Hairui Dong, Zhexuan Huang

items.title: Modulation of the Endocannabinoid System by Cannabis sativa Bioactives in Alzheimer’s Disease: Therapeutic and Nutritional Implications
items.abstract: Background: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by cognitive decline, neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, amyloid-β accumulation, and tau pathology. Current therapies provide limited symptomatic relief, highlighting the need for novel therapeutic and nutritional approaches. Objective: This review aimed to evaluate the therapeutic and nutritional implications of Cannabis sativa and its bioactive compounds in AD management, with emphasis on molecular mechanisms, clinical evidence, extraction technologies, and emerging therapeutic opportunities. Methods: A comprehensive review of the scientific literature was conducted, focusing on cannabinoids, non-cannabinoid phytochemicals, hemp-derived nutritional compounds, preclinical findings, clinical studies, and recent advances related to AD. Results: Evidence indicates that cannabinoids, particularly cannabidiol (CBD) and Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC), may modulate neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, amyloid-β aggregation, tau hyperphosphorylation, and neuronal survival pathways. Emerging compounds, including acidic cannabinoids, minor cannabinoids, polyphenols, flavonoids, hemp-derived bioactive peptides, and root alkaloids, have demonstrated additional neuroprotective potential. Clinical studies primarily support cannabinoid-based interventions for improving behavioral and neuropsychiatric symptoms rather than modifying disease progression. Hemp seeds and hemp-derived products also provide nutritional bioactives with potential complementary benefits. Conclusion: Cannabis sativa represents a promising source of therapeutic and nutritional bioactive compounds for AD management. However, larger standardized clinical trials are required to confirm efficacy, safety, and disease-modifying potential before widespread clinical application can be recommended.
items.authors: Érica Fátima Rachelle, Jaqueline Vanz, Bruna De Lima Hennig, Silvane Roman, Juliana Steffens, Clarice Steffens

items.title: Positive Reinforcement Training in Captive Wild Mammals: An Integrative Review
items.abstract: This review critically evaluates the impact of positive reinforcement training (PRT) on wild mammals maintained in ex situ environments, highlighting its role in enhancing animal welfare. The synthesis consolidates recent research on how PRT influences mammalian behavior and physiology with a focus on training techniques and types of reinforcers employed. A total of 46 studies from the past decade were analyzed: 17 directly examined the effects of PRT and 29 explored its application within broader ex situ management strategies that incorporated PRT alongside other approaches. Of these, 35 articles detailed the specific positive reinforcers used during training sessions. The findings demonstrate diversity and facilitate the adaptation to management routines, promote behavioral diversity, and decrease the occurrence of stress-related behaviors. Factors such as social interactions, individual motivation, and the variety of reinforcers significantly influence training outcomes. This review provides a foundational framework for applying operant conditioning with positive reinforcement to improve management protocols, veterinary procedures, and conservation efforts. It also emphasizes the need for further research to integrate PRT into projects involving biological sample collection and animal handling, with particular attention to individual animals’ needs and personality traits.
items.authors: Lara Caveanha Gragnanello, Mateus José Rodrigues Paranhos da Costa, Cristiane Schilbach Pizzutto, Cynthia Fernandes Cipreste, Robert John Young, Aline Cristina Sant’Anna

items.title: Neural Interfaces for Bidirectional Sensory Restoration in Limb Prostheses: Current Evidence and Clinical Translation
items.abstract: Background: Restoration of sensory feedback has become one of the major goals of modern bidirectional neuroprosthetic rehabilitation, enabling the transition from conventional prosthetic replacement toward bidirectional neuroprosthetic systems capable of restoring physiological sensorimotor communication. This narrative review aims to provide a comprehensive and clinically oriented overview of current neural and related sensorimotor interfaces for upper- and lower-limb prostheses, focusing on their mechanisms of sensory restoration, clinical performance, and translational potential. Methods: A targeted literature search was conducted in PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science to identify clinical, translational, and landmark studies published between January 2010 and June 30, 2026. Sources were selected according to prespecified relevance criteria consistent with the narrative design of the review. Owing to the heterogeneity of the included technologies, study designs, populations, and outcomes, the evidence was synthesized narratively. Earlier seminal publications were included when relevant to the physiological basis of sensory restoration and the historical evolution of neural interfaces. The selected literature was analyzed thematically according to neural interface technology, sensory restoration strategies, functional outcomes, and clinical translation. Results: Evidence from small pilot studies and experimental evaluations suggests that direct peripheral and central neural interfaces, biological or regenerative interfaces, neuromuscular signal interfaces, non-invasive sensory-feedback systems, and integrated prosthetic platforms may contribute to the restoration or substitution of tactile, proprioceptive, thermal, and multimodal sensory information. Emerging technologies, including regenerative peripheral nerve interfaces, fully implantable wireless systems, biomimetic sensory encoding, adaptive closed-loop control, and artificial intelligence-assisted decoding, may support further clinical translation, although most remain investigational. However, the available evidence remains limited by small patient cohorts, heterogeneous methodologies, and a lack of standardized long-term outcome measures. Conclusions: Neural and related sensorimotor interfaces have shown the feasibility of providing sensory feedback in selected experimental and early clinical settings. Although no single technology currently fulfils all clinical requirements, the integration of complementary biological, neural, and computational approaches appears to represent the most promising pathway toward personalized neuroprosthetic systems with the potential to improve sensorimotor function, although long-term clinical and quality-of-life benefits remain uncertain.
items.authors: Fabiana Battaglia, Cristiano De Marchis, Mariarosaria Galeano, Gabriele Delia, Filippo Cucinotta, Felice Sfravara

items.title: Quantitative Validation of a GNSS Campaign Planning Model for Kinematic Surveys: A Comparison of GPS and GPS/GLONASS Configurations
items.abstract: Reliable georeferencing is a fundamental requirement for modern sensor-based environmental monitoring systems employing mobile sensing platforms. This study presents a quantitative validation of a GNSS campaign planning model for kinematic surveys and evaluates how extending a single-constellation GPS configuration to a dual-constellation GPS/GLONASS configuration affects model-observation agreement under real-world conditions. The analysis was based on a kinematic measurement campaign conducted along an 18.4 km route in the Tricity metropolitan area (Gdańsk-Sopot-Gdynia), Poland. Two GNSS receivers operating at 1 Hz were used simultaneously, providing GPS and GPS/GLONASS observations under comparable kinematic and environmental conditions. Model predictions derived from DSM and DTM data were compared with field observations in terms of PDOP, satellite visibility, and model-observation agreement. The results demonstrate that the GPS/GLONASS configuration substantially improved satellite constellation geometry relative to the GPS-only configuration. Mean PDOP values decreased by approximately 30%, while the number of visible satellites increased by 81–86%. More importantly, the GPS/GLONASS configuration improved model-observation agreement. The mean absolute model-observation PDOP difference was reduced by 58.0% for the entire route, 66.7% under favourable observation conditions, and 68.4% under challenging observation conditions. The greatest improvements in model-observation agreement were achieved in dense urban environments affected by signal obstructions. These results demonstrate that constellation configuration influences not only satellite constellation geometry but also the agreement between trajectory-based campaign-planning predictions and real kinematic observations. The proposed methodology may also support the planning of sensor-based environmental monitoring campaigns requiring favourable GNSS observation conditions along measurement trajectories.
items.authors: Mariusz Specht, Sławomir Figiel, Cezary Specht

items.title: A Prediction-Enhanced Polynomial Kalman Filter Using Higher-Order Predictive Representations for State Estimation
items.abstract: The conventional Kalman filter operates primarily in the original first-order state-prediction space, which limits the explicit utilization of higher-order state-coupling and predictive statistical structures. To enlarge the candidate prediction space, this study proposes a Prediction-Enhanced Polynomial Kalman Filter (PEPKF). Through Kronecker augmentation, the original one-step prediction is extended to second-, third-, and higher-order polynomial representation spaces, introducing nonlinear internal predictive transformations while preserving the linear physical state-space model. The resulting higher-order quantities are formulated as equivalent predictive pseudo-observations and fused with the original prediction through weighted least squares to construct an enhanced prior, followed by the standard Kalman measurement update. Numerical simulation results show that PEPKF achieves better state-estimation performance than the conventional KF, thereby demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method.
items.authors: Jing Long, Haiyang Zhang, Chenglin Wen

items.title: Beyond Traditional Risk Scores: Artificial Intelligence in Coronary Plaque Characterization and Personalized Atherosclerosis Management
items.abstract: Atherosclerosis remains a leading global cause of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality, yet its insidious progression and multifaceted etiology, spanning genetic, metabolic, and environmental determinants, often delay clinical recognition until adverse events occur. Traditional risk stratification tools, while foundational in preventive cardiology, are constrained by their reliance on limited variables and static linear assumptions, frequently misclassifying individuals at the extremes of risk. This review critically examines the transformative role of artificial intelligence (AI), particularly machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), in redefining atherosclerosis management across three interconnected domains. First, we explore how AI-driven predictive models integrate high-dimensional data, from genomics and imaging to real-time wearable metrics, to achieve superior cardiovascular risk stratification compared with conventional scores. Second, we detail AI’s capacity to automate and enhance plaque characterization through advanced imaging analysis, enabling reproducible quantification of burden, composition, and vulnerability markers that are imperceptible to human readers. Third, we investigate AI-powered clinical decision support systems, digital twins, and reinforcement learning approaches that facilitate dynamic, personalized treatment planning tailored to each patient’s evolving profile. We also critically address the ethical imperatives, algorithmic fairness, data privacy, transparency, and accountability, alongside practical challenges of clinical integration, regulatory validation, and health equity.
items.authors: Rassulbek Aipov, Timur Saliev, Baurzhan Aipov, Zulfiya Kachiyeva, Aksoltan Oradova, Ildar Fakhradiyev
items.category_raw: Journal of Cardiovascular Development and Disease

items.title: GRACE-PSO: Particle Swarm Optimization with Group Rank Assessment and Cooperative Evolution
items.abstract: Particle swarm optimization (PSO) is a widely used bio-inspired optimization method. However, global guidance can align particle trajectories, reduce population diversity, and lead to premature convergence. To address this issue, we propose GRACE-PSO, a particle swarm optimizer based on group rank assessment and cooperative evolution. The method introduces group-best learning as an intermediate layer between personal-best and global-best learning to improve the balance between exploration and exploitation. GRACE-PSO integrates three coupled mechanisms: (1) a group-learning update that provides the population with multiple group-specific search directions; (2) a rank-based group-utility assessment that evaluates relative search effectiveness through pairwise comparisons of personal-best fitness values; and (3) a utility-driven adaptive strategy that adjusts the strengths of group-best and global-best learning and selectively reinitializes a small number of underperforming particles in stagnant groups. Experiments on 29 CEC 2017 benchmark functions at 30 and 50 dimensions against seven representative PSO methods show that GRACE-PSO achieves average ranks of 1.2414 and 1.3793, respectively. Experiments on two practical flexible intelligent metasurface optimization problems further demonstrate its competitive performance and practical applicability.
items.authors: Honggang Wu, Jinxiao Li, Yufei Zhang, Lidong Gu, Pengyu Wang

items.title: Perioperative Hydrogen Inhalation and Postoperative Pain After Endoscopic Discectomy: A Pilot Non-Randomized Clinical Study with Exploratory Murine Data
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Postoperative pain after endoscopic discectomy may reflect acute surgical nociception superimposed on pre-existing radicular symptoms. Molecular hydrogen (H2) has antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, but clinical evidence for perioperative analgesia is limited. We evaluated the association between perioperative H2 inhalation and postoperative pain and analgesic requirements. Methods: This open-label, non-randomized pilot study enrolled 37 patients in two consecutive periods (H2, n = 25; control, n = 12). Because original outcome records for 12 H2-period participants could no longer be retrieved at the time of manuscript preparation, the complete-case clinical analysis included 25 source-verifiable participants (H2, n = 13; control, n = 12). H2 was delivered via nasal cannula as a 66.7% H2/33.3% O2 source gas at 2 L/min (estimated inspired H2 approximately 4%). Pain was evaluated with a numerical rating scale (NRS) preoperatively, at post-anesthesia care unit (PACU) arrival, at 1, 6, 12, and 24 h, and at 1 month. Longitudinal scores were analyzed using generalized estimating equations with Holm-adjusted comparisons. A parallel exploratory murine chronic constriction injury (CCI) experiment (n = 6/group) assessed mechanical allodynia over 14 days of daily H2 inhalation. Results: The group-by-time interaction was significant (Wald χ2(6) = 56.68, p 0.001). After Holm adjustment, pain scores were lower with H2 at PACU arrival (difference, −3.21; adjusted p = 0.002), 1 h (−2.42; adjusted p = 0.004), and 1 month (−3.45; adjusted p 0.001). Intraoperative fentanyl use and rescue analgesic use were also lower in the H2 group; no adverse events were documented in the analyzed cohort. In the murine CCI experiment, H2-treated mice showed higher ipsilateral paw withdrawal thresholds than air-exposed controls. Conclusions: Perioperative H2 inhalation was associated with lower pain scores at selected time points and reduced analgesic requirements. These preliminary findings require confirmation in randomized trials. Trial registration: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05476575.
items.authors: Chao-Hsien Sung, Wen-Chin Ko, Chia-Chi Kung, Chi-Feng Hung

items.title: The Historical Trajectory of Dermatology in Europe and Brazil: A Systemic Reading of the Relationships Between Skin, the Subject, the Environment, and Care
items.abstract: Dermatology has historically evolved from the observation of visible skin lesions to a complex medical specialty shaped by scientific, institutional, technological, and social transformations. This article aims to analyze the historical trajectory of dermatology through the milestones that transformed practices of care, considering the relationships between skin, subject, environment, and care. This is a historical–reflective study based on a narrative literature review conducted in PubMed/MEDLINE, SciELO, LILACS, and Google Scholar, complemented by primary treatises and institutional documentary sources, covering indexed publications issued between 1950 and 2026 in English, Portuguese and Spanish, addressing the development of dermatological knowledge from ancient civilizations to contemporary practice. The analytical scope was deliberately delimited to the European and Brazilian trajectories, and other traditions are referred to only where they establish contrast. The analysis shows that dermatology was progressively structured through clinical observation, morphological classification, standardized terminology, clinicopathological correlation, hospital-based teaching, scientific societies, specialized journals, and technological innovations such as medical photography, dermoscopy, non-invasive imaging techniques, teledermatology, and artificial intelligence. In Brazil, the specialty developed through the expansion of medical education, specialized services, scientific production, professional certification, continuing education, and public health campaigns. From a systemic perspective, these milestones reveal a shift from a mechanistic view centered on cutaneous disease to a broader understanding of the individual within biological, subjective, social, environmental, technological, and healthcare contexts. This trajectory was, however, neither linear nor uniformly beneficial: stigmatization, unequal access, and dependence on technology accompanied it and persist in certain contexts. Dermatology’s history is therefore not only a history of diseases and techniques, but also of changing ways of observing, interpreting, and caring.
items.authors: Luana Pizarro Meneghello, Julieli Rosso, Silvia Naujorks, Carla Lizandra de Lima Ferreira, Keity Láis Siepmann Soccol, Juliana Catucci Boza

items.title: Discriminative Performance of Routine Inflammation- and Nutrition-Based Indices for Histopathologically Confirmed Gastric Malignancy: A Retrospective Case–Control Study
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: This study aimed to evaluate the discriminative performance of routine systemic inflammation- and nutrition-based indices for distinguishing histopathologically confirmed gastric malignancy from non-malignant endoscopic findings. Methods: This retrospective case–control study included 211 patients who underwent upper gastrointestinal endoscopy with histopathological evaluation: 139 non-malignant endoscopic controls (129 benign/non-neoplastic and 10 premalignant findings) and 72 gastric malignancy cases. Premalignant lesions were not considered malignant outcomes. Discrimination was evaluated using univariable ROC analyses and multivariable logistic models. The fixed predictor set was assessed using 10-fold out-of-fold validation and 500-resample bootstrap optimism correction; a separate fully nested selection-inclusive audit was used to quantify uncertainty arising from variable selection. Results: NLR (AUC = 0.792), INR (AUC = 0.791), and SIRI (AUC = 0.783) showed the highest univariable discrimination. Among the variables retained in Model 1, higher ESR and RDW, lower MPV and HDL, higher INR values, and male sex showed statistically significant multivariable associations. Model 1 had an apparent AUC of 0.928 (95% CI, 0.890–0.959), a fixed-set 10-fold out-of-fold AUC of 0.890, and a bootstrap optimism-corrected AUC of 0.901. A fully nested selection-inclusive audit yielded an out-of-fold AUC of 0.873 and a bootstrap-corrected AUC of 0.869. Conclusions: Routine inflammation- and nutrition-related laboratory measures discriminated gastric malignancy from non-malignant endoscopic findings in this endoscopy-selected cohort. The model remains exploratory and requires prospective external validation. These data do not establish screening performance or diagnostic accuracy for early or asymptomatic gastric cancer.
items.authors: Muammer Bilici, Dilek Ayvaz, Didem Güney, Ünzile Işıl Yüce, Selim Aydemir

items.title: Regulation of Membrane Association and Downstream Effector Interaction of K-Ras by Its Hypervariable Region
items.abstract: The small GTPase Ras, a central switch in signal transduction of cell growth, is a crucial element in the development of many forms of cancer. Recent studies have shown that membrane association of Ras is essential to its downstream effector recruitment and signal transduction. Here we investigate the membrane association and interaction of K-Ras4B, the most frequently found Ras isoform in tumor cells, using all-atom molecular dynamics simulations totaling 8.5 μs. We find that the isoform-specific, farnesylated hypervariable region (HVR) of Ras plays an important role in the organization and oligomerization of its globular domain (G-domain) on the surface of the membrane. We show that the overall pose of the Ras G-domain on the membrane can be determined by its HVR. The HVR thus can control downstream effector binding by positioning the G-domain on the membrane in a specific orientation. Furthermore, we observe that the HVR alone already transiently dimerizes in the membrane and recruits negatively charged phosphatidylserine lipids around the K-Ras isoform-specific poly-lysine region. The observed HVR dimerization potentially can initiate the dimerization of the full K-Ras, which is essential for downstream effector signaling via various pathways. These atomistic details behind the molecular mechanism of the HVR provide novel insight into Ras interaction with membrane and its availability for downstream effectors.
items.authors: Anda Trifan, Hossein Omidi Ardali, Josh V. Vermaas, Till Rudack, Emad Tajkhorshid

items.title: An Improved DeepLabv3+-Based Framework for Field-Road Extraction and Structural Indicator Quantification in Well-Facilitated Farmland
items.abstract: Well-facilitated farmland plays an important role in stabilizing and increasing crop yields, advancing agricultural mechanization, and improving production efficiency. Field-road quality directly affects machinery access and the transport of agricultural inputs and harvested crops. Current acceptance inspections rely mainly on field surveys and spot measurements, resulting in limited spatial coverage, low efficiency, and poor reproducibility. Therefore, a method is needed to rapidly survey entire field-road networks, extract road extents and structural indicators, and generate verifiable inspection records. Centimeter-resolution UAV imagery enables flexible and repeatable data acquisition, but deriving acceptance-oriented indicators remains challenging. Narrow field roads are readily obscured by crops and shelterbelt shadows or confused with cropland textures, resulting in blurred boundaries, discontinuities, and false detections. We developed a lightweight UAV-based framework integrating field-road segmentation and structural-indicator quantification. MobileNetV2 replaced the DeepLabv3+ backbone, while a Normalization-based Attention Module and Content-Aware ReAssembly of FEatures enhanced interference suppression and spatial reconstruction. Morphological processing, skeleton extraction, Euclidean distance transformation, and skeleton-graph analysis were then used to quantify road width and network connectivity. Across three training runs with different random seeds, the model achieved mean mIoU, mPA, and precision values of 93.34%, 96.75%, and 98.90%, respectively. The model had 6.14 million parameters and an inference speed of 17.04 FPS. After averaging five measurements from each road segment, the R2 values between the predicted and manually measured widths were 0.650, 0.486, and 0.662 for asphalt, concrete, and gravel roads, respectively. The corresponding width MAEs were 0.130, 0.140, and 0.100 m. Connectivity analysis yielded an index of 1.00 in the first validation area, while gap repair increased the index from 0.4682 to 0.4795 in the second area. The framework supports efficient, quantitative, and traceable acceptance inspection of field-road infrastructure in well-facilitated farmland.
items.authors: Yongsheng Liu, Chunling Chen, Sheng Xu, Shuai Feng, Zhonghui Guo, Tongyu Xu

items.title: Plant Behaviour, Adaptive Plasticity and Evolution: Reassessing the Debate on Plant Intelligence
items.abstract: In recent decades, plant sciences have profoundly transformed our philosophical understanding of plants, moving beyond the traditional view of the plant organism as a passive, mechanical entity devoid of agency. Contemporary research into plant physiology, chemical communication and adaptive strategies has helped to outline a theoretical framework: plants emerge as complex systems, capable of environmental perception, signal integration, physiological memory and flexible responses to stimuli. Recent findings have stimulated an extensive interdisciplinary debate on whether plants should be attributed forms of cognition or even intelligence. This paper critically analyses the relationship between plant behaviour and evolutionism, examining the concepts of adaptation, communication and plant intelligence in the light of evolutionary biology, the philosophy of mind and the epistemology of the life sciences. This review examines how the case of plants helps to redefine traditional categories such as organisms, behaviours, subjectivities and cognition. It opens up new theoretical perspectives for a non-anthropocentric philosophy of life.
items.authors: Claudia Rosciglione

items.title: Environmental-State-Driven Robust Neutral-Point Impedance Configuration for Coastal Low-Voltage IT Systems
items.abstract: Coastal low-voltage isolated or impedance-earthed-neutral (IT) systems are capable of continuous power supply following the first earth fault. However, environmental erosion and converter-related system unbalance render the neutral-to-earth characteristics of such systems highly dependent on insulation performance and protective-earthing-path conditions. This paper proposes an environmental-state-driven and traceable configuration method for fixed series resistance–inductance neutral-to-earth branches. The method represents environment-dependent variations in system insulation and protective-earthing paths through temperature, humidity, salt contamination, and component aging and establishes four coupled environmental states accordingly. For each candidate neutral branch configuration, three critical indicators, i.e., neutral-point displacement voltage, first-earth-fault current, and touch voltage, are comprehensively evaluated. A common robust feasible region satisfying all prescribed environmental states is extracted through full-state constraint screening. Infeasible configuration candidates are traced to their dominant environmental states and restrictive constraints. Furthermore, a Pareto max–min selection criterion is adopted to determine the optimal configuration, which maximizes the minimum normalized safety margin without requiring additional empirical trade-off weights or online parameter retuning. A 400 V primary case study, complemented by cross-site climatic and electrical-system transferability assessments, demonstrates the applicability of the proposed framework over the investigated conditions.
items.authors: Yangqing Li, Yanmin Wang, Yuxiao Li, Yiguo Li

items.title: Existence and Stability of Positive Solutions for a Class of Delta Fractional Perturbed Problems
items.abstract: The aim of the present work is to study a class of perturbed delta Riemann–Liouville (RL) fractional problems coupled with Dirichlet conditions. Our new results improve significantly upon the existing results, as we show that the related Green’s function, which can be expressed as an infinite series, is actually positive under suitable conditions.
